name: Amaori Natore
source:
Race: Hume

An employee of the coffee shop Usui, located near the Trigger Detective Agency. Her personality is cool, cold, and she has a sharp tongue. She is a childhood friend of [url=/c132078]Kai[/url] and [url=/c132447]Saina[/url]. While she is often acts coldly towards Kai, due to his recklessness, she seems to be worried about him as well......?
